The workbook Internal Quality Checks!D7 historical no-network wording is superseded by Quality Checks!D7, the frozen skill delivery profile and current policy. The hard execution promise is bounded: environment/instructions/security.md:5 excludes arbitrary blocking browser-native operations and generated machine code; :7 explicitly refuses dynamic execution/extra workers/modules while permitting harmless text; :9 distinguishes app CDN assets from snippet network access. behaviour.md:9 assigns one five-second budget including scheduled callbacks; :11 separately keeps completed previews interactive; :13 specifies latest-success rollback, completed Stop preservation and permits a static restored picture. :15 fixes one-based entered-source and full-HTML line coordinates. :25-29 defines exact record fields, case-sensitive trimmed titles, revisions, unchanged stale-save state and retained draft/reapply behavior. These can be implemented with browser isolation/instrumentation plus transactional SQLite revision checks; runtime.ts:24-26,130-132,359-370 and server.js:8,52-60,84 show concrete implementation paths. S05 records all four parent-document/storage accesses blocked after successful own-document work. S07 records successful matching fetch/image transport controls with delivery baseline 2 and no extra deliveries from snippet attempts. S13 records entered-source rejection lines 2/2/6. S22 records saved records retained across actual process IDs 16 to 347; S23 records successful revision 2, stale revision 1 refusal with HTTP 409 and unchanged record, then deliberate revision 3 reapplication, with reversed-role repetition.
